name: pixart-sigma-1024-torchtrt
description: PixArt-Sigma XL-2 via torch-trt (T5EncoderWrapper + PixArtDiTWrapper + VAEDecoderWrapper). Per-component cosine similarity against HF + end-to-end image generation sanity.
prompt: A photo of a cat sitting on a windowsill at sunset
notes: Torch-TRT PixArt-Sigma: torch_tensorrt compiled engines with fp16 precision. Per-component stages compare individual engines (T5, DiT, VAE) via cosine similarity against HF. End-to-end uses simplified DDIM scheduler (not identical to diffusers DPM-Solver++), so pixel-level PSNR/SSIM will be low — focus is on valid image generation.
